title: Fast play (FP)
description: This modpack increases your FPS by a ton if your GPU supports Vulkan and adds the essentials to minecraft so you can hop onto your worlds or server and play (without the hassle).
body:
Hi, welcome to _Fast play_ (FP).

I created this modpack so players can quickly hop into their words or server and play **lag free** and without the hassle of installing every single mod, installing dependencies, checking if mods are compatible, yata yada yada..

This mod pack usually triples my fps (comapred to base minecraft) and I can reach around 250 consistantly on a laptop 1650 GPU.

Warning:
- This modpack requires your GPU to support **Vulkan** (It probably does.)
- Adding mods to this modpack that use **OpenGL** will break the modpack as it uses Vulkan
  therefore those mods are incompatiable with this modpack.

Last thing, have fun!
